query:
UPDATE whatsappSessions ws
JOIN (
  SELECT approverId, requestNumber, MAX(id) as maxId
  FROM whatsappSessions
  WHERE requestNumber IN ('SOL-2026-0170','SOL-2026-0166','SOL-2026-0165','SOL-2026-0164')
    AND status = 'pending'
  GROUP BY approverId, requestNumber
) keep_ids ON ws.requestNumber = keep_ids.requestNumber
          AND ws.approverId = keep_ids.approverId
          AND ws.id != keep_ids.maxId
SET ws.status = 'expired'
WHERE ws.requestNumber IN ('SOL-2026-0170','SOL-2026-0166','SOL-2026-0165','SOL-2026-0164')
  AND ws.status = 'pending';
